subject: Access evidence request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC for Acme Health
messages:
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access evidence request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC for Acme Health

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking meeting time last week. As part of our SOC 2 and vendor onboarding checklist we need the following items to validate your access control posture for Acme Health (HIPAA environment):

- SAML/SSO metadata and assertion example (IdP/SP exchange).
- SCIM provisioning logs (sample csv) demonstrating user create/update/deprovision flows and timestamps.
- RBAC matrix showing roles, permissions, and mapping to least-privilege principles.
- Confirmation of SCIM delta vs full sync cadence and any retry/backoff behavior.

Can you please provide the items above and indicate if there are any fields in the SCIM logs that will need redaction (PII or PHI)? Ideally we need these uploaded to a secure share by EOD Thursday 6/5 so our risk team can complete the SIG questionnaire.

If you have a short doc that maps the evidence to SIG/SOC 2 control IDs that helps speed review.

Thanks,

Emma Collins
Security Program Manager
Acme Health
emma.collins@acmehealth.com

Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

Plan:

If anything changes well escalate. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access evidence request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC for Acme Health

Hi Emma / Laura,

Attached are initial drafts of the items you requested:
- saml-metadata.xml (IdP/SP metadata)
- scim-sync-sample-logs-2025-05.csv (we masked email addresses and user_id hashes)
- rbac-least-privilege-matrix-2025.pdf (role -> permission mapping)
- evidence_to_sig_mapping.md (short mapping of artifacts to SIG/SOC2 IDs)

Notes and open questions:
- The SCIM logs include attributes like email and name; in the sample we replaced emails with hashed values and removed free-text fields that could include PHI. Let us know if you need further redaction.
- Our SCIM connector supports incremental (delta) syncs every 15 minutes; full sync runs nightly. Retries follow exponential backoff (3 retries) before creating an incident.
- The RBAC matrix includes admin, developer, analytics, and read-only roles; we highlighted least-privilege recommended defaults.

Can you confirm receipt and whether the masking approach meets Acme's requirements? Happy to run a short screen-share to walk through the logs if helpful.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml, scim-sync-sample-logs-2025-05.csv, rbac-least-privilege-matrix-2025.pdf, evidence_to_sig_mapping.md

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access evidence request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC for Acme Health

Thanks Rishi — received the files. A few clarifications before our risk team accepts them: 

- For the SCIM sample: please remove any timestamp fields that indicate exact login times for PHI-associated users; we only need provisioning events (create/update/deprovision) with dates (YYYY-MM-DD) not full timestamps.
- For the SAML example: can you include a short example of an assertion (masked) showing the NameID and one attribute statement (role) — we just need a single assertion to validate mapping.
- For the RBAC matrix: please call out which roles have the ability to export data and which have access to customer data. That's a blocker for our privacy review.

Once those three items are updated we should be good to finalize. Thanks for being quick on this.

Emma

Thanks for the quick review and the clarifying notes. We updated the artifacts per your requests and uploaded everything to a secure share: https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure-share/acme-iam-evidence-2025

What we changed:
- SCIM sample: removed full timestamps, retained YYYY-MM-DD provisioning dates; all email addresses replaced with hashed ids; removed free-text attributes that could contain PHI. File: scim-sync-sample-logs-2025-05.csv

- Mapping doc: updated evidence_to_sig_mapping.md to reference SOC2 CC6/CC7 and SIG control IDs where applicable.

If you'd like a 20-minute walkthrough of the artifacts we can do a screenshare tomorrow morning. Otherwise, please confirm receipt and whether the evidence closes your open items.

Best,
